item.title: Bailey Maupin scores 25 to lead No. 18 Texas Tech women over Houston 85-61
item.description: HOUSTON (AP) — Bailey Maupin scored 25 points and No. 18 Texas Tech cruised to an 85-61 victory over Houston on Saturday night.
